overview_description.description: Expo is a software development platform that provides an open-source framework for building native applications across Android, iOS, and the web using JavaScript and React. It offers a full-stack environment that includes development tools, libraries, and cloud-based services to support the entire application lifecycle, from coding to deployment and updates. The platform includes a software development kit (SDK) with pre-built modules that enable access to device features such as cameras, notifications, and deep linking. It also provides building services, submitting, hosting, and updating applications, along with workflows that automate testing and release processes. Additionally, Expo includes monitoring and analytics capabilities that allow developers to track application performance, usage, and errors after deployment.

about_short_description.short_description: Expo is a full-stack React Native framework that accelerates the app development lifecycle with robust cloud services.

product.name: Expo Framework and SDK
product.description: A full-stack React Native framework and SDK for building native iOS, Android, and web applications from a shared codebase, with more than 100 production APIs.

product.name: Expo Application Services (EAS)
product.description: A cloud service platform for building, distributing, updating, automating, and monitoring Expo and React Native applications across mobile and web platforms.

product.name: EAS Build and Hosting
product.description: Cloud infrastructure for creating application builds and distributing Expo and React Native apps to Android, iOS, and the web from a shared codebase.

product.name: EAS Update
product.description: An over-the-air update service for delivering JavaScript and asset changes to deployed Expo and React Native applications without waiting for a full store release.

product.name: EAS Workflows
product.description: A CI/CD automation service for running builds, tests, application-store releases, and updates for Expo and React Native projects.

product.name: EAS Launch
product.description: A guided service for preparing and submitting Expo applications to app stores, including technical configuration needed for release.
